title: ranunculus limoselloides f. minor
intro: Ranunculus limoselloides f. minor, commonly known as Alpine Buttercup, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Ranunculaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, potentially helping to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus limoselloides f. minor include its ability to reduce inflammation and its potential to act as an antioxidant, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. Bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
